name: The Airtex Group
old_description: Established as an agricultural textile manufacturer in 1918, The Airtex Group has become a leading cut and sew manufacturer in the industry. Our Minneapolis, MN headquarters is home to an experienced team proven to take home décor textile solutions, custom cases, and contract sew programs from initial design through product delivery. We value our clients and look to grow long-term partnerships by successfully reaching project goals by supporting cut and sew solutions both through domestic and offshore manufacturing options.
about:
The Airtex Group was founded in 1918 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as an agricultural textile manufacturer. Over more than a century, the company has evolved into a cut-and-sew specialist serving a global customer base from its headquarters at 1620 Broadway Street NE. The business remains privately held, though specific ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

Today the firm designs, develops, and manufactures custom sewn textile products, handling processes that include cutting, sewing, filling, printing, and weaving. It operates both domestic production in the United States and coordinates offshore manufacturing partners, and reports having produced more than one billion units since inception. The facility at 1620 Broadway Street NE houses design, prototyping, and production under one roof.

The company’s customer base spans home décor, bedding, consumer bags, pillows, soft seating, OEM components, and window treatments. Long-term relationships are common, with many clients remaining for decades, and the firm emphasizes collaborative partnerships to meet project goals.

Airtex emphasizes its 100-year legacy of in-house design and strict quality control, offering end-to-end services from initial concept through final delivery, and highlights the flexibility of domestic and offshore options to meet project requirements. The company states its unwavering dedication to quality and craftsmanship as a core differentiator.
